30 weeks = 30 × 7 = 210 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 211 days.  
Start: 1110-12-04 (YYYY-MM-DD).  
Add 211 days:  
December 1110 has 31 days, so from Dec 4 → 27 days left in Dec → 27 days used.  
211 − 27 = 184 days left.  
1111 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days.  
184 − 181 = 3 days into July 1111.  
So date = 1111-07-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1111-07-04
